sentences.reference: I'm thinking about joining the photography club.
sentences.fullSentence: Do you know when the club usually meets?

sentences.reference: How was your trip to the mountains?
sentences.fullSentence: It was much colder than I expected.

sentences.reference: Our flight was canceled this morning.
sentences.fullSentence: Were you able to book a later one?

sentences.reference: Did you finish the book I lent you?
sentences.fullSentence: No, I haven't read the last chapter yet.

sentences.reference: The new café on Main Street is really popular.
sentences.fullSentence: Can you tell me what time it opens?

sentences.reference: Why did Sam leave the party so early?
sentences.fullSentence: He said he had to study for a test tomorrow.

sentences.reference: I'm going to the grocery store later.
sentences.fullSentence: Could you pick up some milk for me?

sentences.reference: What did the manager ask you in the interview?
sentences.fullSentence: She wanted to know how long I had worked at my last job.

sentences.reference: Which movie should we watch tonight?
sentences.fullSentence: Have you seen the one that won the award?

sentences.reference: The concert tickets are almost sold out.
sentences.fullSentence: Then we should buy ours as soon as possible.
